title: vlm.py dies with a bare TimeoutError when Ollama connects and never answers
body:
## Summary
The third Ollama failure door had no sentence (vision/vlm.py:64-82).

## Description
ea844157 named "unreachable" and "model missing". urllib wraps a timeout only while sending; waiting for the reply raises a bare TimeoutError that ask()'s `except HTTPError` does not catch, so a cold 27B load or a stuck GPU printed "TimeoutError: timed out" with no host, model or remedy. Registry: error-handling taxonomy-design (timeout and unreachable are two kinds). _post now raises a RuntimeError naming host, model and seconds; not retried.

## Flow
- Ollama accepts the connection and stalls
- ask(..., timeout=600)
- bare traceback after 10 minutes

## Expected impact
The operator reads what to check (`ollama ps`). Could break: nothing (404, 400-retry and closed-port paths unchanged, probed).

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - every failure door says what to do
Before: bare TimeoutError
After: RuntimeError with host, model, 1 s, 1 post; 404/400/closed unchanged
Method: probe - local silent socket and HTTP stubs; no gate runs Python here
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: vision/vlm.py:72-82 (before) catches HTTPError and URLError only; CPython urllib do_open wraps OSError around h.request(), not h.getresponse()

title: The bench passed on the recorded set for a replay file it could not read
body:
## Summary
answers() dropped unknown sections, problems, pages, queries and stages silently (tools/lab-bench.cjs:75-85).

## Description
Pair of 4570d955 (which refused an unknown ARGUMENT): a fixture with "hint" for "hints", a problem or query not in the corpus, a page "math" for "maths", or a stage "hint3" was laid over nothing; the run scored the recorded answers and printed pass, exit 0. Registry: test-harness unreached-decisions-pin-nothing. fixtureProblems() now names each key; the CLI exits 2 and runBench throws.

## Flow
- write a leaky fixture with a typo'd key
- npm run bench -- --replay f.json
- pass, exit 0

## Expected impact
A fixture meant to fail the bench cannot pass it by a typo. Could break: a caller using a key the bench does not run (none in tree; model-drift tests green).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - a fixture is read in full or refused
Before: 0/5 unreadable fixtures refused
After: 5/5, CLI and runBench; accepted-key guard exit 0
Method: gate - lab-bench-test case 14, red then green
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: tools/lab-bench.cjs answers(): Object.assign(a.read, over.read || {}); hints/picks likewise; no check on Object.keys(over)

title: ACCEPT is judged over the lab's lesson menu with no tie to desk's library
body:
## Summary
vision/poc_retrieval.py TITLES/ACCEPT and desk/src/lib/library/lessons.data.ts were two unlinked lists.

## Description
The bench scores production pickLesson() (desk's library) against ACCEPT (judged over the lab's 8 TITLES). A maths lesson added to desk would make a right pick score wrong and break the "none is right" queries; a dropped one would leave ACCEPT unpickable. Same 8 ids today by luck. Registry: test-harness gate-scope-is-not-report-scope. lab-bench-test case 15 pins the two lists equal and every ACCEPT/RUN3 id a desk lesson.

## Flow
- add a percentages lesson to desk
- production picks it for "15% of 240"
- the bench scores it wrong; C may fail for a right answer

## Expected impact
Whoever grows the library is told to re-judge ACCEPT. Could break: a desk library edit now turns lab-bench-test red until ACCEPT is re-judged (intended).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - drift between ground truth and menu is caught
Before: 0/2 seeded library changes noticed
After: 2/2 (lab title removed; desk lesson added; both restored byte-for-byte)
Method: gate - lab-bench-test case 15 with seeded controls
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: vision/poc_retrieval.py TITLES (8 ids), ACCEPT; desk/src/lib/library/lessons.data.ts 8 maths lessons; tools/lab-corpus.cjs validated ACCEPT keys only, not ids

title: poc_hints leaks() flags "this 6-sided" and "axis 3" as leaked answers
body:
## Summary
The answer-context words were matched on space-stripped text (vision/poc_hints.py:91-102).

## Description
With every space removed, `is` matched inside "this" and "axis", so a bare small answer after those words read as a leak; poc_hints_es imports the same function. Fixed: bare numbers are matched on space-normalised text with whole words; multi-character terms still on the space-free text.

## Flow
- hint says "Draw this 6-sided shape"
- answer is 6
- leaks() returns "6"

## Expected impact
The lab's automatic leak count stops over-counting. Could break: nothing on the record (24 recorded stages: 0 flags before and after).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - leak check precision
Before: 6/8 walked lines judged right
After: 8/8; recorded stages 0 -> 0 flags
Method: probe - walked lines and the 24 recorded stages in prototype/data.json
Result: better
Gate: none

title: vtt.py still reads a NOTE, STYLE or REGION block's lines as caption text
body:
## Summary
desk's parseVtt learned the block rule today (08d7f244); vision/vtt.py, which promises to keep in step, did not.

## Description
vtt.py dropped only a line starting with NOTE; a block's further lines joined the previous cue and a STYLE block's CSS could reach a retrieval window. Ported the in_block rule.

## Flow
- a VTT with a two-line NOTE between cues
- stamped()
- the previous cue carries the comment

## Expected impact
The lab and the product read captions the same way. Could break: nothing on real lessons (14/14 identical).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one VTT reading
Before: 1/2 desk fixtures read as parseVtt reads them
After: 2/2; 14/14 real lesson VTTs unchanged
Method: probe - desk VTT-3/VTT-4 fixtures through vtt.stamped; real lessons before/after
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: desk/src/lib/library/vtt.ts:11,22 inBlock rule (08d7f244); vision/vtt.py:198 "keep the two in step"; vision/vtt.py:220 (before) startswith NOTE only

title: No gate runs any Python in the lab: every vision fix is probe-only
body:
## Summary
Five vision-lab fixes across two rounds (ea844157, ba543c6b, c7215d2e, fc92e29d, 1ab97a1d) were verified by throwaway probes no suite re-runs.

## Description
lab-bench-test reads the Python as text by design ("No Python runs"), so a regression in vlm.py's failure doors, vtt.py's parity with parseVtt, or leaks() is invisible to every gate. The probes this round are small and deterministic (stdlib only, local sockets); they could be one suite that skips where Python is absent.

## Flow
- someone edits vision/vtt.py
- npm --prefix desk test is green
- the parity with parseVtt has silently broken

## Expected impact
Lab regressions are caught where desk's are. Could break: a CI runner without Python (skip, as with PowerShell).

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - lab fixes stay fixed
Before: 0 suites execute vision/*.py
After: not built: desk/package.json is a shared surface and the suite is M
Method: simulation - this round's three probes are the suite's cases
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: tools/lab-bench-test.cjs:6 "No Python runs"; git log -- vision/ shows probe-only Methods in ea844157, c7215d2e, fc92e29d, 1ab97a1d
instrument: tools/vision-lab-test.cjs in desk rulesSuites (before harness-rules-test): spawn python if present (skip otherwise, as device-rules-test does for PowerShell), py_compile vision/*.py, run vtt.stamped over library-rules-test's VTT fixtures, and vlm.ask against local stubs (closed port, 404, 400-then-ok, silent socket)
